description: This file defines a React component MapView that renders a Google Map within a web application. It manages loading the Google Maps API, displays a placeholder on load failure, and initializes the map centered at a specified location with a marker. The component also prepares for rendering a polyline, though that part is currently a placeholder.

methods.name: MapView({ center, polyline })
methods.description: React functional component that displays a Google Map centered at the provided coordinates, with loading and error handling.
